final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.observstation, step1.count, CAST(step1.count AS REAL) / step2.total_count as ratio FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT step3.observstation, step3.count, step3.ratio, step3.ratio - step4.avg_ratio as deviation FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
